svg.text: Uniform 4 mm frame. PCB and lever nut seat directly on the crossmembers.
Six 4.0 mm through bores; 0.35 mm conical lead-ins widen to 4.7 mm.
Corner cutouts: 13 mm radius / 26 mm diameter. Main cross: 10 mm wide.
Planar routes: matrix 39.4 / 50.8; controller 41.4 / 100; ribbon 219.1 / 254 mm.
19 mm lever pitch. Prefer 4 mm long inserts; longer inserts protrude below.
Print sizing coupon first. No physical insert or connected-cable test yet.
